title: Dipole radiation: near-to-far and near-zone projection against analytic Hertzian fields, native far-field pattern convergence

fixture.analytic_faces: tests/test_radiation.py: six midpoint-quadrature planes on the box (-0.65, 0.65) x (-0.7, 0.7) x (-0.6, 0.6) um carrying the complete analytic Hertzian dipole E and H (1/r, 1/r^2, 1/r^3 terms) for dipole moment (0.3+0.1i, -0.2i, 1) offset (0.12, -0.08, 0.05) um from the box centre, wavelength 1.55 um, exterior index 1.3 (and lossy 1.3+0.05i with mu 1 or 1.1+0.02i), samples per face axis 14, 28, 56, float64 CPU; far field at five directions +-x, y, z and (1,2,3)/|.| and at r = 0.5 m; near zone at five points 0.55 to 1.35 um outside the box and on spheres of radius 200 and 2000 um
fixture.native_dipole: tests/test_radiation_dipole_pattern.py via benchmarks/radiation_dipole.py: vacuum 2.4^3 um box, Ez point source at the origin, wavelength 1.1 um, 2-cycle Gaussian, meshes 0.1, 0.075, 0.05 um (24^3, 32^3, 48^3 cells, 262, 350, 525 steps), physical time 50 fs and PML 0.3 um fixed, near-to-far box +-0.6 um with 32x32 quadrature per face, 39 directions (13 theta values at phi = 0, pi/4, pi/2), float32 CUDA, least-squares scale against 1 - dz^2
fixture.native_vjp: tests/test_radiation.py: tests/test_differentiable.py project 3d with 35 steps, 1.6 x 1.5 x 1.4 um, mesh 0.1 um, 3 PML cells, float64 CPU, six FieldMonitor planes at +-0.3 um with 5x5 quadrature, far intensity and near-zone Poynting objectives
fixture.pml: 0.3 um fixed in the native pattern study; 3 cells in the native VJP fixture; none for the analytic faces

precision: float64 for the analytic projection checks
float32 for the native pattern study and the FP32 projection checks
backend: cuda for the native pattern study and tests/test_radiation.py::test_nearzone_cuda_matches_cpu
reference_method: Closed-form Hertzian dipole fields and far-field complex amplitude (2 pi/lambda)^2 p_transverse exp(-i k d.shift), including phase; Poynting theorem between the closed near-surface flux and the sphere-integrated far power; the far-field limit of the near-zone projection; the analytic sin^2 theta pattern of a z dipole for the native time-domain run with mesh refinement at fixed physical box, PML and time.

observables.name: far_amplitude_relative_l2
observables.definition: relative L2 of the complex far-field amplitude against the analytic amplitude with translation phase, over five directions, at 14, 28, 56 samples per face axis

observables.name: nearzone_fields_relative_l2
observables.definition: relative L2 of all six projected near-zone components against the analytic dipole at five points

observables.name: near_flux_versus_far_power
observables.definition: closed-surface Poynting flux against the 12x24 Gauss-Legendre sphere integral of the far intensity

observables.name: nearzone_to_farfield_limit
observables.definition: near-zone versus far-field model difference at radii 200 and 2000 um

observables.name: native_pattern_relative_l2
observables.definition: relative L2 of the scale-fitted native far intensity against 1 - dz^2 at three meshes

observables.name: native_objective_vjp
observables.definition: autograd derivative of far and near-zone objectives against central differences

native_pattern.fixed: physical time 50 fs within one time step, PML 0.3 um

acceptance.source_of_limits: repository-recorded budgets; the program declares no numeric dipole limit beyond convergence and pattern agreement, and the phase limit 0.02 rad applies to the complex far amplitude whose relative error 2e-4 bounds the phase error by 2e-4 rad on the declared five directions

not_yet_covered: surface-position dependence: no test moves the near-to-far box and bounds the change of the far field (the stored-box adapter rejects a shifted face; phase_origin is the only varied position)
phase of the native time-domain far field against the analytic value (the native study compares the scale-fitted magnitude pattern only)
convergence order of the native far field in dt and PML depth (the study holds them fixed and sweeps the mesh only)

error_budget.precision_floor: float64 projection floors 1e-12 to 1e-15 in the identity checks; float32 projection 2e-3 relative at 28 samples per face axis; float32 native pattern floor not separated from the mesh error
error_budget.time_window: native pattern study: 50 fs fixed within one time step across meshes; native VJP: 35 steps
error_budget.pml: native pattern study: 0.3 um fixed across meshes; no PML sweep for the far field
error_budget.quadrature: the analytic-face tests converge in the midpoint sample count with observed halving ratios above 3.5 (order about 2); the native study converges in mesh with recorded errors 1.03, 0.54, 0.23 percent

notes: tests/test_radiation_dipole_pattern.py is added with this case as a thin wrapper of benchmarks/radiation_dipole.py whose criteria (monotone decrease, final error below 1 percent) were declared with the record docs/validation/radiation_dipole_3060.json; its pilot at this commit reproduced 1.031, 0.541 and 0.230 percent. The far-field phase is checked on analytic input only.
